_FLOW: A ledger of the archive's registered predictions and falsification conditions. TWO LAYERS. Layer 1 is a systematic extraction: 451 conditions harvested from the 326 deposits that carry a NAMED falsification section, classified by how each would resolve. Layer 2 is a hand-verified set of predictions whose outcome is known, weighted deliberately toward the ones that FAILED. A prediction ledger whose entries all came true would be evidence of a ledger written after the fact.
method: Structural, not semantic. A registered prediction is distinguished by carrying a RESOLUTION CONDITION, and resolution conditions live in named sections. Regex on prediction language returns 939 candidates across 415 deposits, most of them conditional prose. Regex on falsification-section HEADINGS returns 326 deposits and 359 sections, from which 451 individual conditions were extracted. The section is the discriminator.

findings: 200 conditions are VERIFIABLE NOW — resolvable by checking a surface, a commit, a hash or a deposit. Anyone could resolve them today.

164 conditions — more than a third — DO NOT STATE A RESOLUTION ROUTE. That is a defect class: a falsification condition that does not say how it would resolve is a gesture, not a condition. Naming it here is the first step to fixing it.
Only 9 carry a clock. The archive registers many more conditions than it schedules.

layer_2.note: SIX RESOLVED WRONG, ONE WITHDRAWN, FIVE OPEN. The failures are the point: a hypothesis that failed within an hour of being proposed, two pre-registered predictions falsified by the archive's own battery, a duplicate gate that returned a false negative, and three claims this archive made about its own capabilities that its own corpus refuted.

the_credential: An archive's registered predictions are worth exactly what its failed ones are worth. The most valuable rows here are RESOLVED — WRONG.
coverage: Layer 1 is a census of named falsification sections, not of all registered predictions — conditions stated in body prose without a section heading are not captured. Layer 2 is a curated set, not a sample.
next: Resolve the 200 verifiable conditions. Assign resolution routes to the 164 that lack one. Schedule the 9 that carry clocks.
